answer_1.quote: In recent years, generative LLMs have gained recognition for their impressive ability to produce coherent language across different domains.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on detecting the origin of generated text rather than generating text per se, but it involves analyzing outputs from various LLMs trained on human and machine-generated text.
